subject: Quick check about the deadline shift
text:
Hi, hope your week is going okay. I wanted to ask a quick question about the dates for the next round of edits. I saw the note that the review session might move, but I am not certain how that affects the actual deliverable. If the meeting shifts to Tuesday afternoon, is the written summary still due Friday, or do we now need it by Monday morning?

I am asking because I have a short window open today and tomorrow to finish the formatting, and I would rather do it while the files are fresh. A time-sensitive supplier delay has thrown a tiny wrinkle into my schedule, and I do not want to push the work to the last minute. If anything important has changed, even a one-line note would help me lock in the plan.

I realize these dates may still be in flux, so please do not feel pressured to give a firm answer immediately. A general sense of the timeline would be enough for me to arrange the remaining tasks around the change.

Thanks for sorting this out. Let me know if Friday remains the safer target.
